context: Yumiko is taking both kids on the bus to a museum. She's managing one excited Hina and one curious quiet Sho.
purpose: family-on-the-move tableau — three voices coordinating in a small public space

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: High child bright pointing excitement, the burst of childish wonder, soft real joy threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん、可愛い形ね。ちょっと声小さくね。
lines.en: Yes, what a cute shape. A little quieter, please.
lines.style: Maternal warm gentle volume-management, the affectionate redirect audible, soft real care threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Tiny six-year-old quiet observation, the soft contribution carrying real attention, soft small wonder threading throughout.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: うわ、本当だ、しょうくんすごい！

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 次の駅で降りるから、準備してね。
lines.en: We get off at the next stop, so get ready.
lines.style: Maternal warm practical instruction, the gentle coordination audible, soft real care threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Tiny six-year-old soft request, the gentle reaching audible in the question, soft small wanting throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん、もちろん。一緒に降りようね。
lines.en: Yes, of course. We'll get off together.
lines.style: Maternal warm tender response, the soft real care audible, gentle love threading throughout delivery throughout the response.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: はやく着かないかな、博物館！
lines.en: Wonder when we'll get there, the museum!
lines.style: High child bright impatient anticipation, the eager forward-energy audible, soft real excitement threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: もうすぐよ。静かに待ってね。
